tofu test remains a non-claim; the gate rejects .tofutest.hcl/.tftest.hcl while catalog rows still set tests_present=false.

implemented_claims: First-class local oya gate validate cloud-iac-opentofu-validation dispatcher, usage, run-all, and lane-catalog registration.

Gate reads Cloud IaC manifest and local OpenTofu module catalog, then validates every catalog module in a temporary copy using tofu init -backend=false -input=false -no-color followed by tofu validate -no-color.

Gate rejects generated OpenTofu artifacts in source, backend/provider/resource/data-source blocks, high-confidence raw secret markers, skeleton overclaims, missing main.tofu files, and manifest/catalog drift.
Cloud IaC manifest now records opentofu_validation_scope with exact command posture, official-source references, syntax-repair list, and explicit non-claims.
Invalid HCL variable-block syntax was repaired in k8s-namespace-bootstrap, kms, secrets-bootstrap, and vpc; dns plus repaired modules were normalized with tofu fmt.
explicit_non_claims: No tofu test, plan, apply, destroy, import, drift detection, rollback, or live provisioning runtime is implemented.
No provider APIs, provider credentials, provider blocks, backend state access, provider dependency lockfile, provider provenance, or provider-resource-complete module bodies are claimed.

No live private module registry API, module signing, provider mirror, Argo CD API, Kubernetes API, repository credentials, live sync/diff/health/prune/self-heal, or cosign verification is implemented.
No REST/SDK/worker runtime adapters, measured SLO, active-active DR, live mesh enforcement, autosharding, auto-rebalance, capacity telemetry, or hyperscaler readiness claim is made.
false_green_findings_closed: Cloud IaC manifest previously preserved no init/validate evidence; now local syntax/init/validate evidence is first-class and gate-backed.
Four module skeletons previously failed real OpenTofu parsing despite being listed in the local module catalog; this slice repairs that HCL syntax and prevents future syntax drift from going green.
OpenTofu validation now runs in temp copies, so a green gate cannot be produced by committing generated state/lock/tfvars/plan artifacts into the source tree.
known_gaps: Full ./bin/oya verify --ci-required is not green because of unrelated/concurrent app-shell compile drift, app-shell evidence metadata/audit-chain admission gaps, and pre-existing ADR-shape diagnostics.
Provider dependency lockfile/provenance is still absent and remains a future slice once provider requirements are real and reviewed.
tofu test/plan/apply and provider-resource-complete modules remain future Cloud IaC slices; current evidence is syntax/init/validate only.
The gate uses the local tofu binary observed as OpenTofu v1.12.0; production/CI images must pin and re-check OpenTofu before provider-resource or plan/apply claims.
